privacy.note: Until direct intake is activated, applications are sent by email. When direct intake is activated, only the minimum application fields and contact email are stored in private intake storage with automatic expiry; never store them in the public repository.
privacy.emailHandling: Application sender email is visible in the private email system and used only for application review, approval/KEP-ID reply, and necessary beta communication; never store it in the public repository.

publicBetaHoldPolicy.rule: One current-cycle exact question may remain answered_hold during beta because the product explicitly refuses to guess and routes the user safely. Four questions now have conservative official Sisko/identity safety baselines. The one exact HOLD blocks final Broker Replacement Rate 100% PASS, not beta activation by itself.

safePlatformBaselines.meaning: Supporting-document scan-vs-photo behavior is safe to guide; exact Manufacturing 2026 checklist/file specs remain unresolved.

Safe identity baseline: preserve registered identity exactly, copy document numbers from the matching official document, and route ambiguous address/document-source fields to official help; no Manufacturing 2026 field-by-field mapping is claimed.
Treat final send as non-editable; exact Manufacturing 2026 submit button/status remains unresolved.

Safe completion baseline: upload through Menu Pemenuhan Dokumen, final-send only after review, confirm sent/progress state in Sisko and use the official support channel if unclear; exact Manufacturing 2026 button label remains unresolved.
